method: manual AI interpretation of imagery with owner verification; no model training

VIN.key: Regular parallel rows 2-3 m apart, posts or trellis, soil visible between rows; green May-October

ORC.key: Tree crowns on a grid with round shadows; green all season

ALF.key: Uniform dense green without rows; several cut-and-regrow dips in NDVI; green in several years

ANN.key: Sown rows or uniform field with a clear 2025 growing season; changes between years

GRH.key: White or grey roofs in rows

NCU.key: Field pattern (edges, old furrows) but no 2025 growing season; never called abandoned

GRS.key: Patchy uneven green without rows or tillage

BLT.key: Roofs, paved or packed yards, dirt farm tracks and ditches/canal margins wider than about 5 m inside the parcel

WAT.key: Open water, reeds, dark wet soil

NAT.key: Semi-desert, rock or erosion with no field pattern in any year

TRE.key: One or two lines of tall trees with long shadows; component only, never a parcel's type

order: non_agricultural >= majority -> largest non-agricultural type (never TRE alone)
single perennial type >= majority -> that type
cultivated >= majority -> largest cultivated type if >= majority else MIX

fixed_status.mean_width: 2 * area / perimeter of the official geometry (metres)

weak_spring_peak.condition: 2025 NDVI spring peak (March-May) >= 0.35 and < 0.5, at least 0.15 above the mean of January-February, mean NDVI June-September < 0.3, no detected 2025 annual cycle

natural_ground_crop_season.signal: detected annual-type crop cycle (cycles >= 1) in the year
natural_ground_crop_season.action: contradiction: reconsider as NCU (field, no 2025 season), ANN (2025 season) or defer

alfalfa_cut_signature.action: contradiction: reconsider as ALF (or MIX/PART when only part is alfalfa) or defer

alfalfa_without_cuts.action: contradiction when no year has >= 2 cuts and no year has >= 150 green days: reconsider or defer

evidence.primary: Esri World Imagery tiles (zoom 18-19) drawn in the browser, with photo date from Esri imagery metadata
second: local Sentinel-2 2021-2025 curves and cycle events
hints_excluded: 8526 history and activity classes (product outputs; keeps labels independent)

photo_stage.FLD: field or open land whose 2025 use (ANN, NCU, GRS, ALF) is decided only after the signals
photo_stage.reason: autumn/winter photos show harvested fields; 25% of pilot photo readings were overturned by signals

change_note: 2026-10-30 (owner): alfalfa evidence from the frequent Sentinel-2 series. Cut-and-regrow events per year (NDVI >= 0.5, drop >= 0.2 within 21 days, regrowth >= 0.15 within 50 days, April-October) and green days are shown to reviewers. Calibrated on 187 owner labels: >= 3 cuts in >= 2 of 2023-2025 with >= 120 green days flagged 3/10 owner alfalfa and 4/177 other parcels, so it is used as strong evidence FOR alfalfa (contradiction on ANN/GRS/NCU) and only a weak check against.
